title: DeviceChain command pull response
description: The JSON a device posts to POST /{instanceId}/{tenant}/devices/{deviceToken}/commands/{commandToken}/response to report the outcome of a command it pulled on the HTTP_PULL command channel. The request carries the device's access token in an Authorization: Bearer header; the device and the command come from the URL, and no dispatch nonce is needed. A body that is not JSON, or whose success is missing or not a boolean, is refused with 400 and nothing is recorded. 204 means the outcome was recorded (or was already recorded); 404 means the command is not this device's; 409 means the command is not awaiting an answer.

success.description: true settles the command as SUCCESSFUL, false as FAILED. Required: unlike the MQTT response, an omitted value is refused rather than read as false.

payload.description: The command's result data: any JSON value. A string is stored as its text; any other value is stored as its JSON text. Omitted or null, the command has no response payload.

error.description: Why the command failed. Stored only when success is false.
